name: Bermudian Status -- Spousal Connection (Section 19A)

qualifying_event.description: The spouse, or widow/widower, of a Bermudian may apply to the Department of Immigration for Bermudian status under Section 19A.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of continuous cohabitation as husband and wife for the last 2 years; proof of spouse's Bermudian status.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being married to, or the widow/widower of, a Bermudian, with continuous cohabitation as husband and wife for the last 2 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 2 years of continuous cohabitation as husband and wife with the Bermudian spouse.

requirements.blocker_text: Ordinarily resident status required, typically 7 years for spousal cases per the general residency-continuity rules described alongside this ground.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate the required years of ordinary residence.

evidence_required.document: Form BSA04 or Form 5(2), completed in black or blue ink

sources.title: Government of Bermuda -- Bermudian Status Application: Section 19A spousal connection, 2-year continuous cohabitation requirement, general 7-year residency figure for spousal cases

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Bermuda's initial build. See bm_status_descent.json's notes for why leads_to_citizenship is modelled as false. The source's residency figure for spousal cases (7 years, versus a typical 10 years for other grounds) was stated as a general rule alongside this ground rather than tied explicitly and exclusively to Section 19A -- modelled here as the applicable figure for this route but flagged as a point worth re-confirming against the Bermuda Immigration and Protection Act text directly. This dataset does not separately model an interim/lesser spousal status (unlike Anguilla's Resident Stamp) -- no evidence of one was found for Bermuda in this pass.
